title: 「Only by ... can ...」表示只有透過某種方法，才能做到某事
titleZh: 「Only by ... can ...」表示只有透過某種方法，才能做到某事
titleEn: Using “Only by ... can ...” to express a necessary method

source.file: Sentence Structure 221 - 「Only by ... can ...」表示只有透過某種方法，才能做到某事.pdf

formula: Only by + V-ing + can + subject + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Only by + V-ing + can + subject + base verb + other information

example: Only by listening carefully can we understand what others truly need.
exampleZh: 只有透過仔細聆聽，我們才能明白別人真正需要甚麼。

examples.en: Only by listening carefully can we understand what others truly need.
examples.zh: 只有透過仔細聆聽，我們才能明白別人真正需要甚麼。
examples.highlight: Only by listening carefully can we understand what others truly need.

meaning.zh: 這個句型強調必須採取某個行動或使用某種方法，才能達到後面的結果。

rules.zh: 是介詞。當後面表示一個行動時，動詞須使用 V-ing 形式。 Correct: Only by practising every day can you improve. Incorrect: Only by practise every day can you improve.
rules.en: Use V-ing after by because by is a preposition: “Only by practising every day can you improve.”

rules.zh: 當 Only by 短語放在句首時，主句必須使用倒裝語序： can + subject + base verb Correct: Only by working together can we solve the problem. Incorrect: Only by working together we can solve the problem.
rules.en: When the Only by phrase begins the sentence, invert the main clause as can + subject + base verb.

rules.zh: 後面的主要動詞必須使用原形。 Correct: Only by asking questions can pupils understand the lesson. Incorrect: Only by asking questions can pupils understands the lesson.
rules.en: Use the base form after can: “can pupils understand”, not “can pupils understands”.

rules.zh: 句中已有情態動詞 can，因此不需要再加入 do、does 或 did。 Correct: Only by checking the figures can we find the mistake. Incorrect: Only by checking the figures do we can find the mistake.
rules.en: Do not add do, does or did because the modal can already forms the inversion.

rules.zh: 當 only by 短語放在句尾時，不使用倒裝： We can improve only by practising regularly. 當 only by 短語移到句首時，才需要倒裝： Only by practising regularly can we improve.
rules.en: Do not use inversion when the only by phrase remains at the end. Inversion is required when it moves to the beginning.

rules.zh: 這個句型帶有「只有這樣做才可以」的強調意思。因此，前面的行動必須是達到結果所需的方法， 而不應只是其中一個普通建議。 Strong and logical: Only by entering the correct password can users open the protected file. Too strong in many situations: Only by drinking tea can people relax. 喝茶可能有助放鬆，但並不是放鬆的唯一方法，因此不適合使用這個句型。
rules.en: Use the structure only when the method is genuinely necessary, not merely one optional suggestion among many.

rules.zh: 通常不要在 can 前面加逗號。正確：Only by listening carefully can we understand the problem. 錯誤：Only by listening carefully, can we understand the problem.
rules.en: Do not normally place a comma between the opening Only by phrase and can.

rules.zh: 後面仍然先放主語，再使用 be + past participle。 Only by maintaining the equipment regularly can many breakdowns be prevented. （只有定期保養設備，才能避免很多故障。）
rules.en: Passive main clauses are possible: after can and the subject, use be + past participle.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚強調必要的方法，讓讀者知道：如果不先採取前面的行動，後面的結果便難以達 成。
benefits.en: It clearly emphasises the necessary method. The result cannot normally be achieved without the action mentioned first.

benefits.zh: 句型前半部分說明必須採取的方法，後半部分則交代完成這個方法後可以達到的結果。
benefits.en: It connects a method and a result: the first part presents what must be done, and the second explains what can then be achieved.

benefits.zh: 在討論如何解決問題或改善情況時，這個句型能幫助你清楚提出所需行動。 Example: Only by reducing unnecessary waste can the company lower its environmental impact. （只有減少不必要的浪費，公司才能降低對環境的影響。）
benefits.en: It helps you explain solutions and the action required to solve a problem or achieve an improvement.

benefits.zh: 把 Only by 放在句首，可以立即把讀者的注意力帶到最重要的方法或條件上。
benefits.en: It makes the important method stand out by directing attention to the opening Only by action.

benefits.zh: 你不需要每句都以 We can 或 People can 開始，而可以先提出方法，令句式更有變化。 Compare: We can understand customers’ needs only by listening to them. Only by listening to customers can we understand their needs.
benefits.en: It gives sentences greater variety instead of repeatedly beginning with “We can ...” or “People can ....”

benefits.zh: 這個句型特別適合用於討論教育、環境保護、商業、公共政策和解決問題，也適用於作文、報告、 簡報和正式討論。
benefits.en: It is useful in discussions, essays and presentations about education, environmental protection, business, public policy and problem-solving.

questions.prompt: The hospital’s experienced nurses have identified two conditions for staying: better wages and better working conditions.
questions.promptZh: 醫院的資深護士表示，他們繼續留任有兩項條件：更好的薪酬和工作環境。
questions.answer: Only by improving both wages and working conditions can the hospital retain its experienced nurses.
questions.answerZh: 只有同時改善薪酬和工作環境，醫院才能挽留資深護士。
questions.highlight: Only by improving both wages and working conditions can the hospital retain its experienced nurses.

questions.prompt: An algorithm must be tested on diverse groups before a company can determine whether it treats applicants fairly.
questions.promptZh: 公司必須以不同群體測試演算法，才能判斷它是否公平對待申請人。

questions.prompt: What must an organisation do to learn whether its proposed procedures will work in practice? It must involve frontline staff in the planning process.
questions.promptZh: 一個機構必須怎樣做，才能知道建議的程序在實際環境中是否可行？它必須讓前線員工參與規劃過程。
questions.answer: Only by involving frontline staff in the planning process can an organisation learn whether its proposed procedures will work in practice.
questions.answerZh: 只有讓前線員工參與規劃過程，機構才能知道建議的程序在實際環境中是否可行。
questions.highlight: Only by involving frontline staff in the planning process can an organisation learn whether its proposed procedures will work in practice.

questions.prompt: Increasing the water supply alone will not solve the city’s shortages sustainably. Demand must also be reduced.
questions.promptZh: 單靠增加供水量，無法持續地解決城市的缺水問題。用水需求亦必須減少。
questions.answer: Only by reducing demand as well as increasing supply can the city address its water shortages sustainably.
questions.answerZh: 只有在增加供水量的同時減少用水需求，城市才能持續地解決缺水問題。
questions.highlight: Only by reducing demand as well as increasing supply can the city address its water shortages sustainably.

questions.prompt: The public can receive an accurate picture of a study only when researchers publish both positive and negative results.

questions.answer: Only by publishing both positive and negative results can researchers give the public an accurate picture of a study.
questions.answerZh: 只有同時公布正面和負面結果，研究人員才能讓公眾準確了解一項研究。
questions.highlight: Only by publishing both positive and negative results can researchers give the public an accurate picture of a study.

questions.prompt: Investors cannot make a complete judgement about a project unless they consider its financial, environmental and social costs.
questions.promptZh: 投資者除非考慮項目的財務、環境和社會成本，否則無法作出完整判斷。
questions.answer: Only by considering a project’s financial, environmental and social costs can investors make a complete judgement about it.
questions.answerZh: 只有考慮項目的財務、環境和社會成本，投資者才能對項目作出完整判斷。
questions.highlight: Only by considering a project’s financial, environmental and social costs can investors make a complete judgement about it.
